title: 磨损更新后，缺乏可用且高质量的材料，难以将废弃飞船修复为可运行状态。
description: 磨损更新后，缺乏可用且高质量的材料，难以将废弃飞船修复为可运行状态。
evidence: The horror lies in the absolute lack of usable and quality materials since the wear and tear update. It has been impossible for me to get everything I need to turn a derelict into a running ship.
